contract: One id from the system of record on every hop. Each hop woken by a named event. Read by id, never by name or phone after intake. An open exception with a named owner stops the chain. A write counts only when the system of record returns an id that reads back. Durable state lives on the shared record.

Simpro

the system the report is published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: an exception naming the definition's owner or the threshold's person: a source that could not be read, a measure with no definition or two, a threshold that could not be compared, a correction missing a person or reason, or a view that did not read back

nodes.name: Lead Sort
nodes.office_task: Sort the trade office inbox, voicemails and web-form leads included, onto the job or supplier by id, and hold every real reply for a named person.
systems_of_record: the shared office mailbox (Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace) that issues the message_id, where voicemail and website enquiry-form notifications land
the job system that issues the job_id messages are filed against (ServiceM8 or Simpro)
the ledger that holds supplier records (Xero)
the exception desk the business runs, holding the queue table and its items

emits.write: the message filed against the job or supplier record by that record's own id, and for a supplier invoice its attachment filed as evidence with its hash and the message id, where Invoice Check reads it
emits.readback: reading the record by message_id returns the filing with record_ref job:<job_id> or supplier:<id>, and the evidence with the attachment hash; no record_ref back means it was not filed, and the message stays an unfiled task for a named person

emits.write: an item on the exception desk naming the person who owns it, one per thread: a new lead waiting on the office to book and quote, an unmatched or other message left as a task, a complaint handed whole to the owner, or an item past its kind's clock handed to the owner's manager
emits.readback: raising the item returns an item id, and reading the record by message_id returns that item with its kind, record_ref, owner, due date and every outbound with who released it; no item id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Matter Billing
nodes.office_task: When our practice system marks an appearance or signed draft done, draft its invoice in Xero at our rate card, or park it with a reason, and hold it for the solicitor's release.
systems_of_record: the firm's practice management system, which issues the id of each billable task on a matter (carried as job_id)
Xero

emits.write: One draft tax invoice in Xero per completed billable task, referenced to the task id (and the stage under a staged costs agreement), every line a line on the task and every rate read from the firm's rate card at draft time, with any signed variation attached as evidence. A second completion event updates the same draft.
emits.readback: Xero returns the InvoiceID; GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} must return the invoice with Reference job:<task id>, and that id is stamped on the task as seam.invoice_id. No id back is not a write: it raises invoice.write_failed.

emits.write: The invoice leaves only after a release that names the responsible solicitor, or names the rule they set and shows the total is under its threshold; the release and the send time are recorded against the task.
emits.readback: GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} returns it AUTHORISED and sent to the contact, and the task's record read by its id shows seam.release (a person or a rule) and the send time. A send with no release on the record is refused.

emits.write: A parked invoice as an exception on the task: the reason from the standard's fixed list (a code the rate card does not hold, a variation with no signed acceptance, a failed write, or a draft over the release threshold), with exception_owner set to the person the firm named for billing.
emits.readback: The task read by its id shows the open exception with its exception_owner, and the parked draft in Xero carries no rate for the unpriced line; the next run reads it there and stops until exception.closed.

nodes.name: Nudge Desk
nodes.office_task: Every weekday, find our overdue invoices, chase each customer once in the right order, never past the do-not-chase list or the gate, and turn a reply with a date into a promise.
systems_of_record: QuickBooks Online (the ledger that issues the invoice_id)
Gmail (the reminder and the reply, by message_id)
the exception desk the business runs (a sheet or a task list that issues the exception_id)

emits.write: a dated promise to pay, from the debtor's reply, written as a note on the invoice in the ledger: the date, an amount that may be empty, the method if offered, and when it was captured; it sits beside any open dispute and never closes it
emits.readback: GET /v3/company/{realmId}/invoice/{invoice_id} returns the invoice carrying the promise date and capture time; no promise on the read-back means it was not written, and a promise_not_recorded exception is raised

emits.write: an exception on the customer's invoices naming the person who owns it: an open dispute, a relationship-sized balance, a reply with no date, a promise that did not read back, or an override refused for want of a named approver
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the invoice_ids, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

port_of.original_name: Chase overdue QuickBooks invoices with Claude, Gmail, Slack and Google Sheets

nodes.name: Open Home Desk
nodes.office_task: After each open home, follow up everyone who said yes at sign-in with a message I approved, sort their replies, and draft the vendor's report from what buyers actually said.
systems_of_record: the sign-in register the agency CRM exports, or the typed-up paper sheet, which issues the document_id
the agent's mail system, which holds the approved drafts, the sends and the replies (message_id)
the report store the agent and the vendor open, which issues the report_id per version

emits.write: the week's vendor report for one listing, drafted to the agent as a new version, and sent to the vendor only once the agent approved that version
emits.readback: the report store returns a version for the listing, and reading the listing's latest report back returns that version, its counts and verbatim comments, and whether it reached the vendor; no version back means nothing was written

emits.write: an exception naming the agent who owns it: an incomplete register row, no consent at sign-in, the same attendee at two opens, an offer, a complaint, or a reply that fits no class
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the register row or reply it is about, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Parts Quote
nodes.office_task: When a customer's spare-parts enquiry is logged as a job, draft its quote from our own parts price list, or park it with a reason, and leave it for us to send.
systems_of_record: Xero (Items as the parts price list, Quotes)
ServiceM8
Simpro (parts only)

emits.write: A draft quote on the job the parts enquiry was logged as, every line carrying the part's catalogue id and its rate as read from the price list at draft time, ex GST. It is left in draft for the person who owns parts quotes; this node has no way to send it.
emits.readback: The quote is read back by the id the system returned (Xero GET /api.xro/2.0/Quotes/{QuoteID}, ServiceM8 GET /api_1.0/jobquote/{uuid}.json, Simpro GET /api/v1.0/companies/{companyID}/quotes/{quoteID}) and must carry the job id. No id back is not a write: it raises quote.write_failed.

emits.write: A parked quote as an exception on the job: the park reason from the standard's fixed list, the parts that did price with their catalogue ids, the parts that did not, no total, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for parts quotes.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns an exception_id; reading the job by its id shows the open exception with its exception_owner, and the next hop reads it there and stops.

port_of.original_name: Generate & Send Spare Parts Price Quotes with Gmail, Sheets and Gemini AI

nodes.name: Permit Answers
nodes.office_task: Answer the office's permit, inspection, zoning and building code questions from the council and state rules we hold, citing the clause, or hand them to a named person.
systems_of_record: the mail system that issues the message_id the question arrived on (Gmail, Outlook)
the business's own clause library of council planning schemes, building regulations and inspection schedules, with its answer register
the exception desk the business runs, which issues the exception_id

emits.write: an exception on the question's message naming the person who owns it: no jurisdiction given, nothing in the library covers it, a compliance or certificate question for the licensed certifier, a source conflict between two live instruments, or an instrument that moved and is waiting for a named person to accept the change (listing every stored answer that relied on it)
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the message_id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: PO Match
nodes.office_task: Match each emailed supplier invoice against its purchase order and what was received, leave clean ones as draft bills for a person, and raise every mismatch in dollars.
systems_of_record: Xero (the ledger that issues the bill_id and holds the purchase orders)
Gmail (the inbox the invoice arrives in, which issues the message_id)
the receipt record against each purchase order (delivery dockets or quantities marked complete)
the document store where written variation approvals live

emits.write: the supplier bill in Xero, kept as a DRAFT bill (ACCPAY) against the purchase order number printed on the invoice, with the four check results, the receipt it matched and the source PDF in its history; nothing is approved or paid
emits.readback: GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} returns Type ACCPAY, Status DRAFT, the PO reference and the history note; no InvoiceID back means it was not written, an exception is raised and the run stops

emits.write: an exception on the bill naming the person who owns it: the check that failed and the checks that never ran, the difference in dollars, the cumulative position, the source document from the email, and its queue (needs a decision, waiting on the supplier or a receipt, or blocked: no purchase order, or scope with no written approval)
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the bill_id or message_id, the failed check, the dollar difference, the source document and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

port_of.original_name: Automate 3-way invoice matching from Gmail to Xero with Slack and Teams alerts

nodes.name: Practice Desk
nodes.office_task: Sort everything that lands in the practice inbox onto the right client job or supplier, give each one an owner and a deadline, and hold every reply for the owner to release.
systems_of_record: the practice's shared mailbox (Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace), which issues the message_id
the practice manager that issues the client engagement job_id (for example Xero Practice Manager)
the practice's own ledger, for supplier records (for example Xero)

emits.write: the client's message and its attachments filed against the client engagement job by the job's own id, never copied into a folder
emits.readback: reading the record by message_id returns the filing with record_ref job:<job_id>; no record_ref back means it was not filed, and the message stays an unfiled item for a named person

emits.write: an item on the exception desk naming the person who owns it: a message that matched no record or was classified other, a complaint handed over whole, a client reply drafted and awaiting the owner's release, or an item past its kind's clock escalated to the queue manager
emits.readback: raising the item returns an item id, and reading the record by message_id returns that item with its kind, record_ref, owner and due date; no item id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Price Sheet
nodes.office_task: Before each appraisal, draft the vendor's one-page price evidence from comparable sales chosen by written rules, each sourced, and hold it for the agent to approve.
systems_of_record: the agency's listing system, which issues the listing_id for the appraisal and holds the subject property
the recorded sales source the agency already licenses
the document store the approved page and its record of what was shown are published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: the one-pager version the agent approved, released to the vendor named on the listing, with an append-only record of what was shown: every comparable with its source, sale date and read date, the range, the agent's estimate apart, the approval and the date
emits.readback: reading the listing's records back by listing_id and date returns each report_id with its version, released_on and approved_by, matching the approved version comparable for comparable; no id back means nothing was released and an exception is raised

emits.write: an exception on the listing naming the agent: a quoted figure below the evidence (held, with the sales above it), stale sales (held), too few comparables for a range, or an approval not given
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the listing_id, the version, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Promise Watch
nodes.office_task: Turn every client's "I'll pay by" reply into a dated promise on the invoice, and when that date passes unpaid, draft the next chase for the owner to approve.
systems_of_record: Xero (the ledger that issues the invoice_id; the promise is written onto the invoice)
Gmail (the watched inbox that issues the message_id of each client reply and holds the chase drafts)

emits.write: a dated promise to pay on the invoice the client's reply names by its invoice number: date (never empty), amount (may be empty), method if offered, and when it was captured; the follow-up moves to that date
emits.readback: GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID}/History returns the promise note with its date and capture time; no note back means it was not written and an exception is raised instead

emits.write: an exception on the invoice naming the person who owns it: a chase drafted and waiting for approval, a broken promise, a dispute, a relationship-sized balance lifted out of the run, a reply with no single invoice id, a reply with no date, or an override refused for want of a named approver
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the invoice_id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Quote Desk
nodes.office_task: When a job is booked, draft its quote in our job system from our own price list, or park it with a reason, and leave it for us to send.
systems_of_record: ServiceM8
Simpro
Xero

emits.write: A draft quote on the job it was drafted from, every line carrying a catalogue id from the job system's own price list. This node never sends it: quote.sent fires from the job system when the named person releases the draft.
emits.readback: The quote is read back by the id the job system returned (ServiceM8 GET /api_1.0/jobquote/{uuid}.json, Simpro GET /api/v1.0/companies/{companyID}/quotes/{quoteID}, Xero GET /api.xro/2.0/Quotes/{QuoteID}) and must carry the job id. No id back is not a write: it raises quote.write_failed.

emits.write: A parked quote as an exception on the job: the park reason from the standard's fixed list, the priced lines, no total, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for quotes.
emits.readback: The job read by its id shows the open exception with its exception_owner; the next hop reads it there and stops.

nodes.name: Quote Nudge
nodes.office_task: Each morning, find the flooring quotes customers have not answered, draft a low-pressure nudge for the rep to send within the cap, and hand any no or dead quote to a named person.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the quote_id and job_id (ServiceM8, Simpro, or a quote register kept beside Tradify, which has no public API)
Gmail or Outlook (the rep's outbox for the drafted nudge, and the customer's reply by message_id)
the exception desk the business runs (a sheet or a task list that issues the exception_id)

emits.write: the customer's decision on the quote (their acceptance or reply, by message_id) filed as an attachment on the job the quote belongs to, which marks the open item arrived and ends the chase before any further nudge
emits.readback: the job system returns the attachment's id, and reading it back (for ServiceM8, GET /api_1.0/attachment/{uuid}.json) returns the job_id it is related to and the message_id it came from; no id back means it was not filed, and the next run files it again before anything else

emits.write: a hand-off on the quote naming the person who now owns it, for a no, a dispute, a stop-contacting-me, or the cadence cap reached with no decision, carrying every nudge and call so far
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the quote_id, the reason, the exception_owner and the touch history; no id back means nothing was raised and the quote is not touched again that run

nodes.name: Rent Watch
nodes.office_task: Every day, work out which tenancies are really behind on rent, chase only those, and hand anything past a reminder to a named person.
systems_of_record: the property management system that issues the tenancy_id (its tenancy ledger and message log)

emits.write: an exception on the tenancy naming the person who owns it: a stop condition that matched, a failed or stale ledger read, a drafted notice awaiting a named release, a fee held for a person, or an unanswered sequence
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the tenancy_id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Repair Board
nodes.office_task: Send each triaged repair to a licensed trade at a time inside the resident's window, text the resident once, and hand what cannot be placed to the property manager.
systems_of_record: the property management system that issues the maintenance job_id (its work orders, trade panel and licence records)

emits.write: one slot on the maintenance job: the licensed trade, the start and end inside the resident's window, the resolved address, who or which rule set it, and the job version it was made for; updated in place on a change or a displacement, never written twice
emits.readback: the work order returns the slot's external id, and reading the job back by job_id returns that one slot with its trade, times and author; a write with no id back is a failed write, escalated as write_failed, and nothing is sent about it

emits.write: an exception on the job naming the property manager who owns it: an address that will not resolve, no trade with a current licence for the work, a window the job cannot fit, no capacity, no consent to text the resident, a failed slot write, or a routine visit an urgent repair displaced and could not be re-slotted
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the job_id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Ring List
nodes.office_task: Every weekday morning, tell me who to ring today from my own database, why each one, with a short opener drafted, and nothing past the do-not-call flags.
systems_of_record: the agency CRM, or the copied Contacts sheet, that holds each contact row, its last outcome and the do-not-contact register
the place the agent opens each morning (CRM tasks, the Today tab or a morning email), which issues the report_id for each day's list

emits.write: the day's call list for the agent: at most the cap they set, in rank order, each row with its play, the trigger that qualified it, a drafted opener under 40 words and the last outcome. Drafts only: nothing is dialled or sent
emits.readback: the list store returns a report_id for the day's list, and reading that id back returns the same rows in the same order; no id back means no list was published and the run raises an exception

emits.write: a thing to sort out, on top of the list and naming the agent who owns it: a contact missing name, mobile or address, a reply waiting that asks for a price, makes a complaint or asks something the play was not built for
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the contact, the typed reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Site Orders
nodes.office_task: Turn the build's material list into one purchase order per supplier, from stock first and the supplier's own prices, and match every delivery docket back.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id and holds its material list
the supplier portal or job-system purchasing that issues each order's external id

emits.write: an exception on the job or the order naming the person who owns it: an order waiting for a named release (over the threshold, or to a supplier not on the approved list), a code no catalogue holds, an order write with no id back, a docket that matches no sent order, and every delivery variance (short, over, wrong item, changed price, unaccepted substitution)
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the job_id, the order's external id where one exists, the kind and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
